assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original foliage spray RGBA atlas for alpha-tested leaf cards on an ancient desert tree in the game Athen Hill.
Primary request: Create a square 2048 x 2048 pixel atlas containing FOUR separate distinct small leafy twig sprays, arranged as four isolated clusters in a tidy 2x2 atlas grid with generous fully transparent gutters between them. Every cluster must be wholly inside its quadrant, with clear empty space around its edges and no crops. Each spray has a few thin crooked brown-grey twigs and scattered clusters of small elongated oval olive leaves, an irregular branching silhouette with many little gaps THROUGH the spray. Leaves are dusty muted olive #4A5A32, dull sage and brown-olive, with understated small vein detail. Grey-brown twig wood. One spray broad and spreading, one slightly upright, one asymmetric and sparse, one gently drooping; all the same mature dry desert-tree species. Natural branching growth, no geometric uniformity.
Critical transparency requirement: TRUE transparent background with a real alpha channel (RGBA PNG), alpha=0 between leaf sprays, around them, and through all spaces between leaves and twigs. Empty pixels are actually transparent, not painted white, grey, black or a checkerboard. Do not draw any background whatsoever. The clusters themselves have crisp natural cutout edges with minimal antialiasing and opaque leaves. Intended for Three.js alphaTest leaf cards.
Style: Original slightly soft painted real-time videogame leaf texture, restrained dusty color, realistic but simple small leaf silhouettes, no hard plastic or wax.
Lighting: neutral flat diffuse albedo illumination, no ground shadow, no strong directional shadow, no glow, no backlit halo, no glossy highlights.
Composition: Four discrete leaf sprays only on transparency; surface viewed front-on orthographically. The empty gutters and internal holes must remain transparent.
Constraints: No scene, ground, frame, labels, checkerboard pattern, text, logos, watermark, flowers, fruit, insects, grass, giant broad tropical leaves, saturated bright green, dense solid hedge blobs, or overlapping atlas cells. Square image with real alpha transparency, native 2048x2048 requested.
